cases.why: the at-rest mark loses its empty alt text, so a screen reader announces 'up down arrow' on every sortable header on top of the sort state aria-sort already gives it.
a column sorted ascending draws the same up-down mark as the unsorted ones, so nothing on screen says which column the table is sorted by.
'#' becomes a sortable control again. Sorting by the net-rating rank only repeats Net Rating, and it would now draw a sort mark it cannot honour.
